confirmations.subject: intention
confirmations.presentedText:
**My take:** GO to review the tiny helper rehearsal scope, not to implement: one local screen, four fixed after-cleaning slots, manual photo assignment and human confirmation. Synthetic October 9 rehearsal. Full limits and acceptance cases in scope-review.md. (Inference; source: Founder requests exact small scope for review; Crumb proposal.)

**What we are building toward:** Explore whether a tiny local tool can catch missing commercial window-cleaning completion photos before departure; find strongest first use and prepare next step.

**The first user:** Provisional first user: founder as departure-check supervisor of one small commercial window-cleaning crew, on repeat sites with explicit property-manager photo requirements.

**Their pain:** For this property's fixed north, south, west and east after-cleaning photos, gathering onto the supervisor's laptop through the existing shared folder is easy. The painful task is checking all four required views while packing up; a missed east view caused a return. The founder reports two roughly 45-minute returns in their last ten jobs; other supervisors' experience is unknown.

**Evidence so far:** CompanyCam already offers required-photo checklist fields and reference images; Core USD63/month for 1 user, Crew USD129/month for 3, billed annually. Vendor capabilities do not prove demand for this tool. (Reported; source: https://companycam.com/pricing ; https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/6828391-creating-a-checklist ; opened 2026-10-06.) This does not establish demand.

**What could undo it:**

Human must identify the correct current view and usability; the helper cannot judge cleaning quality or manager acceptance. Synthetic rehearsal proves only checking behavior/usability. Session resets on reload; existing shared-folder sync is outside helper. (Inference; source: Crumb proposed limits; founder requires local images and no quality claim.)

**Still unknown:**

Known fixed shot labels and easy laptop gathering. Unknown: browser, file types, actual helper usability, persistence expectations and real-job benefit. Proposed JPEG/PNG, session-only local HTML; no execution evidence. (Inference; source: Founder facts plus explicit Crumb implementation hypotheses.)

Does this capture the direction you agree with, including the doubts? Agreeing lets us keep investigating; it does not approve building.

confirmations.subject: act
confirmations.presentedText:
For Provisional first user: founder as departure-check supervisor of one small commercial window-cleaning crew, on repeat sites with explicit property-manager photo requirements., this is a bounded learning MVP: Show which north, south, west and east after-cleaning photo slots remain missing or unreviewed before departure.

Capabilities: Four fixed named after-cleaning slots.; Manual local JPEG/PNG selection, thumbnails/filenames, replacement/removal.; MISSING/REVIEW/READY with human confirmation, reset and same-file duplicate warning..
Cuts: No uploads, backend, external libraries, analytics or network calls.; No AI classification, cleaning-quality or manager-approval claims.; No reports, exports, sending, accounts or other properties.; No persistence; originals untouched; JPEG/PNG only..
Limits: Session-only; reload clears. Human checks view/recency/usability. Same-file warning cannot catch all duplicates. Existing shared-folder sync outside helper. Synthetic rehearsal cannot establish field adoption, avoided returns or demand.
Success: Missing-east, duplicate, wrong-view human review, all-correct, reset, unreadable and reload cases behave as specified; founder sees remaining slots and checks four correct views within 90 seconds, preferring it to current process.
Failure: False READY or missing/unreviewed slots hidden; confusing/reset/privacy behavior or more effort than plain checklist. Simplify or retain checklist.
Proposed first-user test: 2026-10-09.
Remaining uncertainty: Test whether visual four-slot check reduces comparison effort; field usefulness remains later evidence.

foundation.name: Four-shot local rehearsal

targetUser.value: Provisional first user: founder as departure-check supervisor of one small commercial window-cleaning crew, on repeat sites with explicit property-manager photo requirements.

problem.value: For this property's fixed north, south, west and east after-cleaning photos, gathering onto the supervisor's laptop through the existing shared folder is easy. The painful task is checking all four required views while packing up; a missed east view caused a return. The founder reports two roughly 45-minute returns in their last ten jobs; other supervisors' experience is unknown.

trigger.value: Checking required photos while packing up before leaving this property.
